title: Capsule
description: Frontmatter contract for a release capsule README.

publisher.description: Publisher slug (kebab-case) matching a folder under models/.

summary.description: Short phrase describing what this release lets you do, e.g. "Generate and edit images from text prompts". Used verbatim in the repo README table, CAPSULE-TOC.md, catalog.json, and llms.txt - every one of which shows the model name right next to it, so do not repeat the model name or "on Microsoft Foundry" here. No trailing period; llms.txt adds one where it needs a full sentence.

release_date.description: Public release date (YYYY-MM-DD) — matches the capsule folder name.

last_updated.description: Date this artifact was added or last meaningfully revised (ISO). Drives the ordering and the 'Last updated' column in CAPSULE-TOC.md. Defaults to release_date for capsules when omitted. Kept in frontmatter rather than read from git so a shallow CI checkout produces identical output.

model_card.description: Official model card URL. Prefer learn.microsoft.com when available.

url.description: Official pricing page — surfaced in the Recently added table.

dependencies.description: Capsule-specific Python deps appended to requirements-dev.txt.

notebooks.description: Notebooks shipped with this capsule (paths relative to the capsule folder). Each notebook covers 1–3 concepts; split large releases into multiple notebooks rather than growing one.

domains.description: Real-world domains the interesting use cases explore.
